business_context: A synthetic small retail marketing team wants to reduce campaign rework before content production starts.
goals: Capture the minimum evidence needed for a reviewable campaign brief
Make ownership and acceptance criteria visible before production
non_goals: Publish campaigns or change live advertising budgets
Claim validated market demand or measured commercial impact

evidence.summary: Synthetic marketing coordinators report repeated clarification when audience and channel are missing.
A synthetic workflow review marks audience, approval owner and success metric as the most frequent missing fields.
Synthetic support notes show handoff delays when acceptance criteria are not recorded.
A synthetic stakeholder asks for one-click automatic campaign publishing.

opportunities.title: Standardize campaign intake before production
opportunities.problem_statement: Marketing coordinators lack a consistent way to capture audience, ownership and acceptance criteria before work begins.

opportunities.title: Publish campaigns automatically
opportunities.problem_statement: A stakeholder wants to remove manual publishing steps.

requirements.title: Guided campaign intake
requirements.user_story: As a marketing coordinator, I want required audience, channel and objective fields so that the production team receives a complete brief.
acceptance_criteria: Submission is blocked when audience, channel or objective is blank
The review page shows the originating evidence IDs

requirements.title: Named approval owner and acceptance criteria
requirements.user_story: As a campaign manager, I want a named owner and testable acceptance criteria so that production handoff decisions are explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Every brief names one human approval owner
Every included requirement has at least one testable acceptance criterion

requirements.title: Automatic campaign publishing
requirements.user_story: As a stakeholder, I want the system to publish a live campaign without review.
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a live publish command

feedback.summary: A synthetic review confirms that required intake fields reduce clarification loops.
A synthetic workflow review asks whether an incomplete brief can be saved as a draft before validation.
A synthetic handoff review supports keeping one named approval owner and explicit acceptance criteria.
A synthetic stakeholder restates the publishing request without addressing the external-action boundary.

prototype_screens.title: Campaign intake
prototype_screens.purpose: Capture the minimum complete brief before analysis.

prototype_screens.title: Evidence and requirement review
prototype_screens.purpose: Show why each requirement is included and who owns approval.
